changelog:
@Announcements Ping Retro Rewind v6.13.4 has been released! This hotfix IS required to continue to play online!    

# ⚙️ Other Updates ⚙️
```- Modified the VR calculations to make outlier's VR gains and losses less punishing.
- Players at least 75,000 VR above the room average earn only 15% of their normal VR gains per opponent beaten, but only when the other players VR average is 30,000 VR or less.```

# 🐜 Bug Fixes 🐜
```- Fixed an issue where specific tracks would crash upon load.```

As always, please report any and all bugs to the bug reports channel! This SHOULD be the last hotfix until we release the next major update now that the crashes are hopefully fixed!
Full Download: https://update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/RetroRewind.zip
